Welcome to my E155 portfolio! I'll be using this blog to document lab work, debugging, and reflections as the semester goes on.

For this first post, I wanted to lay out what I'm hoping to get out of MicroPs.

### Why I'm taking this course?

I've done plenty of (vibecoded) software projects, but I've always felt a little removed from the hardware. MicroPs is my chance to finally close that gap.

### Goals for the semester

- **Build good lab habits.** 
    - Reading datasheets, using oscilloscopes/logic analysers, and systematic debugging. 
- **Documents things and add to my GitHub.**
- **Work on a super interesting final project!**

Looking forward to the semester!
